semantics.timing: Pure combinational output follows current inputs after combinational settling; no clock or cycle latency.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement.
semantics.ties: Equal minima produce their shared numeric value.
semantics.transactions: All combinations of four known binary 8-bit inputs are legal; no handshake.

numeric.arithmetic: Comparison and selection only; no addition, rounding, truncation, saturation, or overflow.

verification.oracle: Independent testbench integer oracle scans all four values with a running minimum initialized to 255.
verification.directed: All-equal values across the full range; each input as unique minimum; ties; zero and 255; unsigned boundary 127/128.
verification.sweep: Sweep every a/b pair with c and d fixed at 255, then exercise every value in each unique-minimum position.
verification.checks: Explicit dev_tb top, Icarus -g2012 compile, finite command timeouts, exact output comparison after settling, PASS or fatal FAIL.

specification_ambiguities: Unknown (X) and high-impedance (Z) input behavior is unspecified; verification covers known binary values.
